title: CISA KEV Snapshot - mDNSShark referenced subset

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti AirOS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Certain Ubiquiti devices contain a command injection vulnerability via a GET request to stainfo.cgi.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-300 Router Cleartext Storage of a Password Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: The D-Link DIR-300 router stores cleartext passwords, which allows context-dependent attackers to obtain sensitive information.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DSL-2760U Gateway Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the D-Link DSL-2760U gateway, allowing remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script or HTML.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-600 Router Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-600 routers contain a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability that allows an attacker to change router configurations by hijacking an existing administrator session.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link and TRENDnet Multiple Devices Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: The ping tool in multiple D-Link and TRENDnet devices allow remote attackers to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-645 Router Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-645 Wired/Wireless Router allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a GetDeviceSettings action to the HNAP interface.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Multiple Archer Devices Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in multiple TP-Link Archer devices allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the PATH_INFO to login/.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR WNR2000v5 Router Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: The NETGEAR WNR2000v5 router contains a buffer overflow which can be exploited to achieve remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DCS-930L Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: setSystemCommand on D-Link DCS-930L devices allows a remote attacker to execute code via an OS command.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple WAP Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple NETGEAR Wireless Access Point devices allows unauthenticated web pages to pass form input directly to the command-line interface. Exploitation allows for arbitrary code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DSL-2750B Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DSL-2750B devices contain a command injection vulnerability that allows remote, unauthenticated command injection via the login.cgi cli parameter.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple Routers Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: NETGEAR confirmed multiple routers allow unauthenticated web pages to pass form input directly to the command-line interface, permitting remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel P660HN-T1A Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zyxel P660HN-T1A routers contain a command injection vulnerability in the Remote System Log forwarding function, which is accessible by an unauthenticated user and exploited via the remote_host parameter of the ViewLog.asp page.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Exposure of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple NETGEAR devices are prone to admin password disclosure via simple crafted requests to the web management server.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR DGN2200 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: NETGEAR DGN2200 wireless routers contain a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR DGN2200 Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: dnslookup.cgi on NETGEAR DGN2200 devices with firmware through 10.0.0.50 allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary OS commands

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple NETGEAR devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel EMG2926 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zyxel EMG2926 routers contain a command injection vulnerability located in the diagnostic tools, specifically the nslookup function. A malicious user may exploit numerous vectors to execute malicious commands on the router, such as the ping_ip parameter to the expert/maintenance/diagnostic/nslookup URI.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Hikvision Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Hikvision products contain an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a malicious user to escalate privileges on the system and gain access to sensitive information.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dasan GPON Routers Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10562, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dasan GPON Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10561, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to  the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik Router OS Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS through 6.42 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files and remote authenticated attackers to write arbitrary files due to a directory traversal vulnerability in the WinBox interface.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A command injection vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to run commands.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link Multiple Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple D-Link routers contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for execution of OS commands.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: In MikroTik RouterOS, a stack-based buffer overflow occurs when processing NetBIOS session request messages. Remote attackers with access to the service can exploit this vulnerability and gain code execution on the system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Reolink Multiple IP Cameras OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Reolink RLC-410W, C1 Pro, C2 Pro, RLC-422W, and RLC-511W IP cameras contain an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability allows an authenticated admin to use the "TestEmail" functionality to inject and run OS commands as root.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DNS-320 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: The login_mgr.cgi script in D-Link DNS-320 is vulnerable to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link Multiple Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple D-Link routers contain a command injection vulnerability which can allow attackers to achieve full system compromise.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-859 Router Command Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-859 router contains a command execution vulnerability in the UPnP endpoint URL, /gena.cgi. Exploitation allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute system commands as root by sending a specially crafted HTTP SUBSCRIBE request to the UPnP service when connecting to the local network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Netis WF2419 Devices Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Netis WF2419 devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution as root through the router's web management page.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DWL-2600AP Access Point Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DWL-2600AP access point contains an authenticated command injection vulnerability via the Save Configuration functionality in the Web interface, using shell metacharacters in the admin.cgi?action=config_save configBackup or downloadServerip parameter.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP QTS Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP QTS contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing remote attackers to inject code on the system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DrayTek Multiple Vigor Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: DrayTek Vigor3900, Vigor2960, and Vigor300B devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability in cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/cvmcfgupload that allows for remote code execution via shell metacharacters in a filename when the text/x-python-script content type is used.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-link TL-WA855RE Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-link TL-WA855RE contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker (on the same network) to submit a TDDP_RESET POST request for a factory reset and reboot. The attacker can then obtain incorrect access control by setting a new administrative password. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Helpdesk Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP Helpdesk contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow an attacker to gain privileges or to read sensitive information.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L Devices Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow for remote administrator password disclosure. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L devices contains a command injection vulnerability in the cgi-bin/ddns_enc.cgi. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Network-Attached Storage (NAS) Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP NAS devices contain a command injection vulnerability which could allow attackers to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DNS-320 Device Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DNS-320 device contains a command injection vulnerability in the sytem_mgr.cgi component that may allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Netgear JGS516PE Devices Missing Function Level Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Netgear JGS516PE devices contain a missing function level access control vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-825 R1 Devices Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-825 R1 devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the web interface that may allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Products Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Multiple DrayTek Vigor Routers Web Management Page Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: DrayTek Vigor3900, Vigor2960, and Vigor300B routers contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple NAS Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Zyxel network-attached storage (NAS) devices contain a pre-authentication command injection vulnerability, which may allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-610 Devices Remote Command Execution
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-610 devices allow remote code execution via the cmd parameter to command.php.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arcadyan Buffalo Firmware Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arcadyan Buffalo firmware contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated, remote attackers to bypass authentication and access sensitive information. This vulnerability affects multiple routers across several different vendors.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Draytek VigorConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the DownloadFileServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Draytek VigorConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the file download functionality of the WebServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS Improper Authorization Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP NAS running HBS 3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability which can allow remote attackers to log in to a device.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC11 Router Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ASUS Routers Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ASUS Lyra Mini and ASUS GT-AC2900 devices contain an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access to the administrative interface. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dahua IP Camera Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dahua IP cameras and related products contain an authentication bypass vulnerability when the NetKeyboard type argument is specified by the client during authentication.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dahua IP Camera Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dahua IP cameras and related products contain an authentication bypass vulnerability when the loopback device is specified by the client during authentication.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Hikvision Improper Input Validation
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A command injection vulnerability in the web server of some Hikvision product. Due to the insufficient input validation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Reolink RLC-410W IP Camera OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Reolink RLC-410W IP cameras contain an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability in the device network settings functionality.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-605 Router Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-605 routers contain an information disclosure vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain a username and password by forging a post request to the /getcfg.php page.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link Multiple Routers Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in all series H/W revisions routers via the DDNS function in ncc2 binary file.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TerraMaster OS Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: TerraMaster OS contains a remote command execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands on the target endpoint.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-820L Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-820L contains an unspecified vulnerability in Device Name parameter in /lan.asp which allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Externally Controlled Reference Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Certain QNAP NAS running Photo Station with internet exposure contain an externally controlled reference to a resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to modify system files. This vulnerability was observed being utilized in a Deadbolt ransomware campaign.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A command injection vulnerability in the CGI program of some Zyxel firewall versions could allow an attacker to modify specific files and then execute some OS commands on a vulnerable device.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link Routers Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link Routers contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that has a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DNR-322L Download of Code Without Integrity Check Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DNR-322L contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS level commands on the device. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Archer AX-21 Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-Link Archer AX-21 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-820 Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-820 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ping_addr parameter to ping.ccp.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple NAS Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Zyxel network-attached storage (NAS) devices contain a pre-authentication command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands remotely via a crafted HTTP request.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls allow for improper error message handling which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute OS commands remotely by sending crafted packets to an affected device.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the notification function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the ID processing function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Multiple Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-Link TL-WR940N V2/V4, TL-WR841N V8/V10, and TL-WR740N V1/V2 contain a command injection vulnerability via the component /userRpm/WlanNetworkRpm. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ASUS RT-AX55 Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ASUS RT-AX55 devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. As represented by CVE-2023-41346.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP VioStor NVR OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP VioStar NVR contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link TL-WR841N Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-Link TL-WR841N contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default, leading to the disclose of stored credentials. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-859 Router Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-859 routers contain a path traversal vulnerability in the file /hedwig.cgi of the component HTTP POST Request Handler. Manipulation of the argument service with the input ../../../../htdocs/webinc/getcfg/DHCPS6.BRIDGE-1.xml allows for the leakage of session data potentially enabling privilege escalation and unauthorized control of the device. This vulnerability affects legacy D-Link products. All associated hardware revisions have reached their end-of-life (EOL) or end-of-service (EOS) life cycle and should be retired and replaced per vendor instructions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Zyxel firewalls contain a path traversal vulnerability in the web management interface that could allow an attacker to download or upload files via a crafted URL.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DrayTek Vigor Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: DrayTek Vigor2960, Vigor300B, and Vigor3900 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability due to an unknown function of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/apmcfgupload of the component web management interface.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link Multiple NAS Devices Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DNS-320L, DNS-325, DNS-327L, and DNS-340L contains a hard-coded credential that allows an attacker to conduct authenticated command injection, leading to remote, unauthorized code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link Multiple NAS Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DNS-320L, DNS-325, DNS-327L, and DNS-340L contain a command injection vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2024-3272, this can lead to remote, unauthorized code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel DSL CPE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Zyxel DSL CPE devices contain a post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the CGI program that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel DSL CPE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Zyxel DSL CPE devices contain a post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the management commands that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands via Telnet.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Edimax IC-7100 IP Camera OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Edimax IC-7100 IP camera contains an OS command injection vulnerability due to improper input sanitization that allows an attacker to achieve remote code execution via specially crafted requests. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-823X Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-823X contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to execute arbitrary commands on remote devices by sending a POST request to /goform/set_prohibiting via the corresponding function. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ASUS Live Update Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ASUS Live Update contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability client were distributed with unauthorized modifications introduced through a supply chain compromise. The modified builds could cause devices meeting specific targeting conditions to perform unintended actions. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that exists in the Parental Control page. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to access files on the underlying system that could be manipulated to access an underlying account.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper input validation vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to conduct command injection.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.
